subject: Cascade Health — activation & implementation kickoff coordination
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Patel <lena.patel@cascadehealth.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@cascadehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T15:12:00Z
Subject: Cascade Health — initial post-sign handoff (SOW attached)

Team,

Quick handoff for Cascade Health (signed yesterday). Summary below so CS and Eng have what they need for kickoff planning. I attached the final SOW and the signed order form.

Deal highlights
- SKU: Dedicated-Resv (2x T4G nodes, reserved capacity)
- Committed throughput: 12k tokens/min sustained, 50 concurrent sessions
- Latency target: 95th < 180ms for their core conversational route
- Data residency: US-East (primary) — customer requires logs retained 30d then purged
- Start date: target production cutover week of 2026-11-22
- Pricing: 12-month term, ARR as in attached SOW

Technical/compliance notes
- Customer will require SSO (SAML), and a private VPC peering between their AWS account and our private deployment (they signed for Private-Control-Plane).
- They asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and a short network diagram for the peering design.
- They expect a pre-cutover perf run to validate 95th latency and steady-state throughput.

Open risks / asks for CS & Eng
1) Can Eng confirm capacity plan and a preflight checklist for a November cutover? (Vivek)
2) CS: propose a kickoff window (2-hour) where we cover roles, runbook, and M1 acceptance criteria. Also confirm which Cascade stakeholders will join (technical + procurement).
3) Legal asked for standard post-signing credits/SLAs — nothing unusual but flagged a 48-hour remediation SLA in the order form.

Attachments: CascadeHealth_SOW_v1.3.pdf (signed), order_form_0821.pdf

Next steps I suggest:
- Hannah: nominate CS owner and run a quick internal pre-kickoff to prioritize items.
- Marissa: send customer proposed kickoff times and request SOC2 report + SSO metadata.
- Vivek: provide preflight checklist by EOD Friday (2026-10-29).

Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Cascade Health — initial post-sign handoff (SOW attached)

Thanks Karthik — good summary. I nominate Marissa as the primary CS owner and Vivek as the technical lead for preflight. Marissa, please own the kickoff scheduling and the mutual action plan (we should track in the Drive link Karthik shared).

Marissa / Vivek: immediate asks from me:
- Marissa: propose two 2-hour kickoff slots next week (11/1–11/5) and a second option in mid-November for the preflight run (target week of 11/15). Include a short agenda: introductions, success metrics & acceptance criteria, SSO/VPC next steps, cutover gating.
- Vivek: confirm whether the reserved nodes in US-East meet throughput and if we need a small burst quota add-on for the perf run. Also provide a one-page preflight checklist covering: network, IAM/service accounts, certs, deployment images, and KV-cache warm-up plan.

Operational notes:
- Customer wants 30d logs retention then purge — that’s within our standard config but flag to Privacy for audit.
- The remediation SLA in the order form (48 hours) is acceptable but we should document escalation path in the kickoff runbook.

Marissa: when you reach out to Cascade, copy Procurement (karthik) for billing/PO coordination and include the SOC2 asset request.

Hannah
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Patel <lena.patel@cascadehealth.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@cascadehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T08:27:00Z
Subject: Cascade Health — proposed kickoff times & pre-kickoff asset request

Hi Lena / Tom,

Congratulations again on getting the contract across the line — excited to partner on the rollout. Per Karthik's handoff, I’m Marissa (lead CS). Would you be able to join a 2-hour activation kickoff with our cross-functional team? Proposed windows (all US/Eastern):
- Tue 2026-11-02: 10:00–12:00 ET
- Thu 2026-11-04: 14:00–16:00 ET

Agenda (high level)
1) Introductions & roles (10m)
2) What success looks like: acceptance criteria & KPIs (20m)
3) Architecture & SSO/VPC design owners (30m)
4) Cutover & perf validation plan (25m)
5) Action items & mutual action plan review (25m)

Pre-kickoff items needed from Cascade:
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted OK) — needed for our compliance folder
- SSO metadata or SP/IdP contact for SAML integration
- AWS account ID + preferred peering CIDR and VPN/contact for network ops
- Primary technical contact for the perf run (name/email)

I attached a mutual action plan (MAP) to start capturing owners and dates: mutual_action_plan_cascadehealth.xlsx. Karthik — I copied Procurement as requested. Vivek — would you and your infra lead confirm the preflight checklist by EOD 10/29?

If neither proposed slot works, please suggest two alternatives the week of 11/8.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_cascadehealth.xlsx

From: Lena Patel <lena.patel@cascadehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@cascadehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:43:00Z
Subject: Re: Cascade Health — proposed kickoff times & pre-kickoff asset request

Marissa,

Thanks — both slots look good. We’ll take Tue 2026-11-02 10:00–12:00 ET. Confirmed attendees from Cascade: Tom Ruiz (Sr. Platform Eng), myself (Head of AI Ops), and our procurement lead (SaaS_PO@cascadehealth.com) — I’ll forward the PO to Karthik this afternoon.

We’ll share SOC2 (redacted) and SAML metadata by EOD Monday 10/31. For the network: our AWS account ID is 987654321000 and our preferred peering CIDR is 10.10.0.0/16.

One additional ask: can you share a short runbook that explains what we should expect during the perf validation window (steps, expected downtime, rollback)? Tom would like to review with our on-call before the perf run.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Lena Patel
Head of AI Operations
Cascade Health
Lena.patel@cascadehealth.com | +1 415-555-0123
